title: Consistency—Capitalisation of Borrowing Costs
summary: Addressed how consistently an entity could choose between expensing or capitalising borrowing costs directly attributable to qualifying assets. Withdrawn in 2007.

related.title: Borrowing Costs
related.relationship: The parent standard whose 2007 revision superseded SIC-2 by making borrowing cost capitalisation mandatory, removing the option to expense
